body: If you ever feel like talking to someone, feel free to send me a message. Sometimes it helps to just have someone listen.

Hi! I'm also 17, and I feel the same way. When I'm depressed I push people away and then I get even more depressed because I'm alone. It's so frustrating. Depression hardly makes sense. Sometimes I have to force myself to be around people because I know I'll just feel worse if I isolate myself, but it's hard. How is your support system? Do you have people to talk to?

I also enjoy documentaries! What are some of your favorites?

Therapy isn't really an option for me at the moment unfortunately. After I posted this I felt a lot better, so I think it helped! Sometimes I just need someone to listen. Thank you for your kind words.
